# Pragmatism Derives From the Greek Word for Action[^1]

The term, pragmatism, is derived from the same Greek word [pi rho alpha gamma mu alpha], meaning action, from which our words 'practice' and 'practical' come. It was first introduced into philosophy by Mr. Charles Peirce in 1878.

[^1]: [[@Pragmatism - William James]]
